notes.title: The Bustling World Update Diary - Apr. | Latest Dev Progress!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! 
As we head into May, Yong'an City is growing more lively by the day!
Today, we'd like to share a quick update on the development progress of The Bustling World, plus share a few behind-the-scenes insights from our producer.

[h2]🌿Latest Progress[/h2]
Development is moving steadily forward, with art, programming, level design, and other teams all pushing forward together.
With more team members onboard, we're able to build a richer, more vibrant world. We hold more than three hours of design meetings every day (yes, seriously) to keep breathing life into the world! 
Here's a quick look at what we’ve been working on recently:

[b]1. UI Redesign and Optimization[/b]
After releasing our last trailer, we received feedback from players about the clarity of the UI. We're now redesigning and optimizing the in-game UI to make it cleaner, more intuitive, and smoother to use.

[b]2. AI System Overhaul — More Lifelike NPCs[/b]
We've made a major update to the AI system. NPC movements are now more natural and fluid.

[b]3. Expanding and Enriching City Life[/b]
- Travel by sedan chair or carriage: Our artists have created a variety of stylish sedan chairs and carriages. Take a sneak peek at one of them below!
- New city activities: You can now take on part-time jobs, host banquets, set up a street stall, and more!
- More areas to explore: Special districts like the famous 烟花柳巷 (similar to a red-light district) are opening up, full of surprises waiting to be discovered.

[b]4. Continuous Improvements[/b]
We’re also fine-tuning a ton of smaller features — improving driving and combat feel, refining swimming animations, upgrading ground textures, refreshing vegetation assets — all the little things that add up to a richer experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/5eebca518ffbcfe493ed6628091a72fc0d6bd5ef.jpg[/img]
[i]Ancient painting references for the carriages[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/b1c70b17bcfebec02cf910ce911fbb7c7687491f.png[/img]
[i]One of the carriages[/i]


[h2]🪵Dev Talk Highlights[/h2]
Last week, our art director Chengzi (Orange) gave a talk at the G-bits Game Developer Alliance online event. For those interested, here's a brief summary of some key points about The Bustling World (edited for clarity):

[b]1. How is The Bustling World different from traditional Chinese RPGs in terms of development, combat strategy, and map exploration?[/b]
Personally, I don't think any single feature on its own would qualify as "innovation." Games are like cooking: you use similar ingredients and techniques, but by mixing them differently — amplifying what you want, toning down what you don't — you can create something new. It's the combination that feels fresh, not any one part by itself. If you break any game down far enough, you'll find echoes of other games in it.

[b]2. Are there dynamic events in the game?[/b]
Yes! Seasonal changes will open and close certain areas, and trigger different events.

[b]3. Some of the small but interesting design touches in the game?[/b]
There are tons, but here's one: Players can practice medicine — and if you accidentally "treat" someone a little too hard and they die, you can organize their funeral. You'll need to buy a coffin, find a burial site, and even arrange a paper-money scattering ceremony. These kinds of little interactions are something we find really fun!

[b]4. What is the overall design philosophy for The Bustling World?[/b]
  We've developed a design methodology that guides us. The first principle is that players should be able to generate their own goals and motivations naturally. If that happens, we consider it a success. And once players have a goal, offering multiple ways to achieve it is a huge bonus.
  On top of that, we strongly believe in the power of imagination. Good game design should surpass players beyond their expectations. If a game can surprise a player and exceed their imagination, it sparks curiosity. Once players encounter something unexpected, they'll be eager to see what comes next.

[b]5. Most exciting and most frustrating moment during development?[/b]
  The most exciting moment was definitely when we finished four years of hard work in silence and then released our first PV. The positive feedback and recognition from players was an unforgettable highlight.
  As for frustration, honestly, there hasn't really been a "frustrating" moment. Our mindset is simple: as long as we're doing what we believe is right and putting in all our effort, we don't dwell on setbacks. If you stay focused on doing the right thing, frustration just doesn't have a place. This is the mentality we've maintained for the last six years (laughs).

That's it for our April Diary! Thank you to everyone who has supported, given feedback, and accompanied us along the way. We'll keep pushing forward — and we can't wait to meet you in the game someday soon!

FireWo Game Studio & Lightning Games Publishing Team

notes.title: The Bustling World Update Diary - Mar. | A Successful GDC Journey!
notes.notes:
Hi there! This is the FireWo Game Studio & LightningGames publishing team.
March has been a busy yet fulfilling month for us. On the development side, our team has expanded to over 50 members, and we're making rapid progress on content development. On the publishing side, we've been preparing for the game's continued promotion and community-building efforts. Of course, the most exciting part of this month was taking The Bustling World to GDC, marking the game's first-ever overseas offline appearance!

[h2]GDC - Global Game Developers Conference | San Francisco, USA[/h2]
From March 19th to 21st, The Bustling World was showcased at [url=https://gdconf.com/]GDC[/url]. The event brought us many valuable experiences and interesting encounters, and we'd love to share them with you:

1. When going through customs, the customs officer knew about The Bustling World! During the booth setup, even the patrolling police officers recognized the game and asked us for more details. Throughout the entire GDC, many attendees mentioned that they had already added it to their wishlists and were pleasantly surprised to see it at the event!

2. While The Bustling World is still relatively unknown in the Western game industry, many industry peers showed a strong interest in the game and approached us for more information.

3. The booth design complemented the game's content perfectly and attracted a large crowd from the National Pavilion area, creating a lively atmosphere. Many attendees' first reactions were "Wow, fantastic!", "Beautiful!", and "Unique art!"—the game's art style and visual presentation received high praise.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/624d90f0335380480b2d7340b87c7133dd595c39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/77919f7436e46e692dfb43979a2282ee9e7ef8f8.png[/img] [i]Booth Design | Setting up requires combining multiple screens [/i]

4. On Twitter, we also received positive feedback and excitement about the game from industry peerss. The images below are from the Director of Sony XDEV and Communications Director and Publishing Manager of PalWorld. Thank you for sharing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/7ed0ff17ddd1d75cf471985f0c9b868232eb29df.png[/img]

5. Many attendees brought up the Three Kingdoms and Tang-Song dynasties, and we were thrilled to see how Chinese culture is becoming more recognized overseas with no apparent culture gap. One developer even emailed us after the event to share how deeply the game resonated with him and his connection to Chinese culture, "The artistry, the storytelling—it all resonated deeply with me." This really touched us.

6. The enthusiasm from attendees was overwhelming! We brought 500 brochures and 350 giveaways, and we nearly ran out on the first day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/a4d6448b7bb9f83fa7eb00efdfe0969dee94ca20.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/f28b0f813eb3ee61cf099be9845780c28a3c3abd.png[/img][i]Brochure | Badge | Chinese Round Fan[/i]

7. GDC also turned out to be a great recruiting opportunity. Many international students and overseas industry professionals expressed interest in joining or supporting our team, with some even offering to relocate to China and Chengdu to work on The Bustling World.

8. As most attendees were industry professionals, we received many technical questions about aspects like rendering techniques, CPU/GPU thread optimization, etc. This also allowed us to meet many tech experts!

And with that, our GDC journey has come to a successful close! From the recognition of our game by international audiences, to professional exchanges with industry peers, and the appreciation of Chinese culture—every bit of feedback has been incredibly encouraging. Thank you for the support and connections that have made what we're doing even more meaningful.

[h2]FireWo Game Studio | Chengdu, China[/h2]
Meanwhile, at FireWo Game Studio in Chengdu, the development team is continuing their dedicated and passionate work. Take a look at the hard-working team in action!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44811022/11fc862d22ad33148b4dd658b54c0a7384c0a766.png[/img]P1: Programmers get new consoles! Installing!
P2: Programmers working hard
P3: Modelers working hard too
P4: Designers working hard in another way
P5: Break time! Enjoying a live jam session by our designer
P6: After a full day of "beastly" work, it's nap time!

If all goes well, we plan to launch offline demo trials in Q4 this year!

That's all for this month's update. Once again, thank you all for your continued support and attention. See you next month!
FireWo Game Studio & Lightning Games Publishing Team

notes.title: The Bustling World Update Diary - Feb | Latest News Inside!
notes.notes:
Hi there! 
This is the FireWo Game Studio & LightningGames publishing team.
We are excited to meet you in this way (it really takes us back to the golden era of blogging). This month's update will be shared here, covering both big events and little fun moments. We're thrilled to share what we're working on with you!

[h2]🎬 Trailer & Livestream [/h2]
At the end of 2024, after a whole year since our first trailer, we released the second trailer for The Bustling World. If you haven't seen it—here it is:
[url=https://youtu.be/vPeSbLdIZe0?si=KSzQVgk5N-bSTeTE]The Bustling World - Feature Trailer | A Beautiful Blend of Art and Freedom in a Chinese-Style World[/url]

On the evening of February 12th, during the Chinese Lantern Festival, we hosted our first-ever livestream on Bilibili! Big thanks to BlazBlue's producer 厂长 from 91ACT for joining us on site, and to 鸡哥 for leading the Q&A online "torture" session! During the livestream, our producer gave an honest behind-the-scenes look at the studio's development, revealed some in-progress footage, and answered the burning questions about gameplay, the workshop and development progress. Catch the details here:

[h2]❓ Player FAQ[/h2]
We've gathered common questions from our community, and our producer's here to give you the answers. Official class rep reporting in!

[b][i]Game Release & Support[/i][/b]

[b]1. What will the game price be?[/b]
The final price hasn't been set yet, but our goal is to keep it affordable so that as many players as possible can enjoy the game.

[b]2. Will the game support languages like Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Portuguese, etc.?[/b]
We'll continue to monitor Steam wishlists and community feedback to determine whether to add more languages based on demand.

[b]3. Why was Kickstarter canceled?[/b]
The funding issue was resolved through company investment. To clarify, we have only accepted financial investment and have not sold any rights beyond equity, ensuring that the team can continue prioritizing game quality and player experience.

[b]4. Will the game have a multiplayer mode?[/b]
We plan to explore a P2P multiplayer mode after launch. However, we won't release it unless we're confident it delivers a great experience, so we recommend keeping expectations in check for now.

[b][i]Gameplay & Mechanics[/i][/b]

[b]1. Will there be rebellions? If I establish my own dynasty, can rebels flood my palace?[/b]
Yes, rebellions will occur, and you'll need to suppress them. Rebels can invade your palace, so you'll have to fortify your defenses.

[b]2. Will there be a family or faction management system?[/b]
There is a similar system, but it doesn't follow traditional SLG-style faction management.

[b]3. Is there a lifespan limit for characters? Can they extend it through cultivation?[/b]
No, characters do not have lifespan limits. This is not a cultivation-based game.

[b]4. Can characters start families? Will there be needs management, such as hunger and thirst?[/b]
The main character can develop romantic relationships with different but fixed NPCs. The game includes a hunger system but does not have a thirst mechanic.

[b]5. How does character customization work? Do we choose traits at the start, or unlock more options throughout the game?[/b]
Character progression is tied to an in-game system where all abilities and stats improve through its mechanics. It functions similarly to a large talent tree (though it's not called that and doesn't follow traditional talent tree mechanics). Additionally, weapons and equipment in the game offer build variety.

[b]6. Will there be a injury system similar to RimWorld or Project Zomboid, or limb based system like in Kenshi? What about poisoning?[/b]
There's no limb health system, but the game includes various buffs. A specific sect in the game specializes in crafting different poisons.

[b]7. Will there be an inheritance system like in Medieval Dynasty? Can you take over as children after death?[/b]
No, the game follows a more traditional RPG structure. Upon death, you'll need to reload a save—unless you die as a result of a death sentence, in which case it works differently.

[b]8. Will farming and animal husbandry include mutation or genetic traits?[/b]
Yes, plants can be selectively bred for better traits, and animals can undergo mutation-based breeding.

[h2]🌏 GDC 2025![/h2]
This March, The Bustling World is heading to GDC 2025! We're excited to connect with developers and players from around the world. If you'll be there, swing by our booth and say hi! Stay tuned—we'll be sharing event updates on social media!

We hope this update gives you a better look into our game's vision, development progress, and upcoming plans. Thank you all for your continued support! 

FireWo Game Studio & LightningGames Publishing Team
